name: finance-analyst
description: Agentic financial analyst and virtual CFO for Indian SMEs: guided onboarding, connector and file-import guidance, data discovery, validation, reconciliation, deterministic metrics with consistent accounting definitions, a Proactive Financial Reflex Engine (automatic read-only investigations, scenarios and charts; approval gates for external or financial actions), evidence-separated findings and recommendations, and one independently verified report (Markdown, HTML, PDF) with a formula-audited Excel dashboard.
